on my previous review below.
I’ve just had a telephone call with Leslie the reception manager who was absolutely amazing today dealing with my issue I can’t thank her enough thank you very much.

I don’t usually like to complain, but I do feel it’s important to give this feedback. A receptionist’s main role is to be polite and helpful, especially when dealing with patients who may already be stressed or unwell.

I called to chase up a sick note that I had been waiting over six days for. I began the call by saying, “Good morning, I’m just chasing up a sick note. I’ve been waiting five days — is that normal, or do I need to be more patient?”

The first response I received was, “Well I have no idea who I’m talking to.” I felt this came across as quite rude. A more polite approach would have been something like, “That’s okay, I’ll look into it for you — can I take your name please?”

The tone of the conversation made me feel quite upset. Eventually, the receptionist did confirm that the sick note was past the normal deadline date and said she would chase it up immediately, which I appreciated.

I would just ask that management remind staff how much a caring, kind, and considerate approach matters.
